purpose: Additive executable chemistry repair of the frozen R4 transformation-coverage contract; no model or label access is added.

inheritance.implementation_source: This v3 file alone is the complete implementation authority; do not merge, inherit, or fill any value from the parent at runtime.

scope.group_unit: frozen D-032 similarity-component proxy; not a semantic SAR-family identity
scope.r4_authority_boundary: Coverage evidence may authorize a separate oracle-contract freeze only; it never authorizes a fit, prediction, metric, scorer, submission, TDI, or transductive operation.
scope.selected_anchor_gate: Structural coverage applies to every public episode with episode_policy_id selected_anchor, independent of endpoint.
scope.later_oracle_prerequisite: A separate oracle contract must preflight trusted selector==CYP3A4 plus complete anchor/query validity before any fit; R4 does not access selector or scorable facts.
scope.local_authoritative_gate: CYP3A4 state-only aggregate gate from the frozen topology viability receipt; no endpoint availability is emitted per row.

direct_projection.record_scanner: RFC4180 quote-aware scan; validate the exact header before yielding any data record.

mask_projection.opaque_suffix_span: anchor_observation_references and anchor_value_availability_mask remain one opaque byte span.
mask_projection.anchor_identity_usage: structural anchor join only; no activity value, selector, or label is exposed
mask_projection.record_scanner: RFC4180 quote-aware scan; validate the exact header before yielding any data record.

extraction_spec_receipt.material_encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON object with sorted keys and compact separators; material includes extraction_spec_id plus the listed extraction subtrees.

candidate_generation.pair_identity: one canonical unordered pair; derive directional views after extraction
candidate_generation.candidate_cap: none for the exact receipt-bound local-pair and episode populations
candidate_generation.constant_embedding_cap_policy: Pass maxMatches=1000000 to every ordinary exact constant-embedding GetSubstructMatches call. A returned tuple of exactly 1000000 matches is treated as truncated and emits AMBIGUOUS/S2; never accept a truncated ordinary map set. Stereo full-graph maps instead use the frozen unbounded maxMatches=0 rule.
candidate_generation.enumeration: Enumerate every valid single-cut and double-cut candidate jointly before ranking; do not suppress double cuts when a single cut exists.
candidate_generation.deduplication: Canonicalize each candidate's labeled fragments, attachments, environments, stereo record, virtual-H record, changed-index sets, and class; deduplicate only byte-identical candidate material.
candidate_generation.tie_policy: After deduplication, chemically distinct candidates tied on every ranking key are AMBIGUOUS; never use molecule IDs or input order as a scientific tiebreak.

fragmentation.order: Enumerate single and double cuts jointly, then deduplicate and rank the complete candidate set.
fragmentation.hydrogen_side_token_canonicalization: Parse either human input notation or RDKit output, then serialize with Chem.MolToSmiles(mol, canonical=True, isomericSmiles=True) and require the exact canonical token [H][*:1].
fragmentation.single_cut_normalization: rdMMPA's empty single-cut core is split into exactly two dot components carrying the same [*:1] label; both constant/variable orientations are tested against exact canonical labeled constants.
fragmentation.double_cut_normalization: rdMMPA's nonempty double-cut core is variable and its dot sidechains are conserved; normalize exactly identity (1,2) and swap (2,1) attachment permutations.

virtual_h_generation.eligible_predicate: A common conserved attachment atom is eligible iff it is a non-dummy heavy atom in the exact conserved constant, its standardized RDKit Atom.GetNumImplicitHs() is at least 1, and replacing one such implicit H with the exact RDKit-canonical [H][*:1] side token creates a valid ordinary single-cut constant without changing any conserved heavy atom.
per_atom_procedure: Use canonical reparsed standardized atom indices and enumerate every common conserved attachment atom in ascending index order.
Require atom.GetAtomicNum() > 1, atom.GetNumImplicitHs() >= 1, and a valid valence-preserving explicit-H construction.
Generate exactly one virtual-H candidate per eligible atom using the canonical [H][*:1] token; never enumerate hydrogen multiplicity as separate candidates.
Canonicalize and deduplicate the resulting candidate material before ranking; a failed construction is omitted, not repaired.
A virtual H contributes zero heavy atoms and zero changed heavy-atom indices; the attachment atom remains in the conserved constant.
virtual_h_generation.atom_order: canonical standardized RDKit atom index ascending
virtual_h_generation.representation: Human input may use [*:1][H], but every fragment equality comparison, class assignment, candidate material, exact-ID byte, and output serialization uses the RDKit-canonical [H][*:1] token; never use an empty side token.

stereo_policy.graph_test: Clone each canonical standardized molecule, call Chem.RemoveStereochemistry, and serialize with Chem.MolToSmiles(mol, canonical=True, isomericSmiles=True, kekuleSmiles=False, allBondsExplicit=False, allHsExplicit=False). VALID_STEREO is considered only when these exact strings are identical; isomericSmiles=True is mandatory here because stereo was explicitly removed and isotope information must remain.
stereo_policy.precedence: For an identical non-stereo graph with explicit, uniquely mapped changed stereo elements, emit one VALID_STEREO candidate with cut_count 0; no single- or double-cut candidate is emitted for that pair. If the graph is not identical, continue ordinary single/double MMP extraction.
stereo_policy.reference_graph: The shared graph_test string is canonical_nonstereo_full_graph. Reparse it once; its RDKit atom and bond indices are the sole reference indices for stereo records in both directions.

raw_stereo_preflight.molecules: Apply this preflight to both exact parsed raw input molecules before standardization and again to both canonical reparsed standardized molecules; this preserves enhanced-stereo evidence that ordinary MolToSmiles serialization may omit.
raw_stereo_preflight.enhanced_stereo: Require len(mol.GetStereoGroups()) == 0. Any ABS, AND, OR, or unknown nonempty stereo group emits AMBIGUOUS/C3 with no candidate, regardless of the apparent atom-level CIP labels.
raw_stereo_preflight.unsupported_raw_tags: Any atom ChiralTag outside allowed_atom_chiral_tags or bond BondStereo outside allowed_bond_stereo_tags, including STEREOANY, STEREOATROPCW, STEREOATROPCCW, square-planar, trigonal-bipyramidal, octahedral, and other non-tetrahedral atom tags, emits AMBIGUOUS/C3 with no candidate.

discovery.order: After raw_stereo_preflight and before clearing stale CIP properties or calling rdCIPLabeler, call the exact discovery function independently on both canonical standardized stereo molecules.
discovery.completeness: Every returned StereoInfo must have type Atom_Tetrahedral or Bond_Double, specified exactly RDKit StereoSpecified.Specified, and receive one allowed kind-specific CIP value after labeling. An unsupported type, Unspecified or Unknown specified state, missing CIP property, or disallowed CIP value emits AMBIGUOUS/C3 with no candidate.

stereo_policy.unsupported_kind_policy: Any potential or changed stereochemistry other than RDKit StereoType.Atom_Tetrahedral or StereoType.Bond_Double, including atropisomeric, cumulene, square-planar, trigonal-bipyramidal, and octahedral stereo, makes the stereo-only row AMBIGUOUS/C3 with no candidate. Do not downgrade to an ordinary MMP record.
stereo_policy.explicitness: Every potential tetrahedral or double-bond stereo element on both sides must be RDKit StereoSpecified.Specified. Before labeling, clear every stale _CIPCode atom and bond property, then call rdkit.Chem.rdCIPLabeler.AssignCIPLabels. Every tetrahedral center must receive R, S, r, or s and every double bond must receive E or Z. Any unspecified, mixed, missing, or unsupported value makes the stereo-only row AMBIGUOUS/C3.

value_vocabulary.source: Exact _CIPCode strings assigned by rdkit.Chem.rdCIPLabeler.AssignCIPLabels after stale atom and bond _CIPCode properties are cleared; raw StereoInfo Tet_CW/Tet_CCW and Bond_Cis/Bond_Trans are forbidden because they are atom-order-relative.

stereo_policy.mapping: Use map_calls exactly, then apply exact_map_filter to every returned tuple before record construction. Enumerate every surviving phi and lambda. For each phi, translate supported discovered CIP elements through lambda and rho, build every valid directional record in reference indices, and retain the lexicographically smallest compact canonical record-array bytes over all lambda. Require the retained bytes for every phi to be identical and non-empty; otherwise emit C3/AMBIGUOUS.

map_calls.phi_tuple: For each returned phi tuple, phi[left_atom_index] = right_atom_index.
map_calls.lambda_tuple: For each returned lambda tuple, lambda[reference_atom_index] = left_atom_index.
map_calls.composition: rho[reference_atom_index] = phi[lambda[reference_atom_index]]; rho therefore maps the same reference atom directly to the right molecule.
map_calls.unbounded: maxMatches=0 is the frozen RDKit 2026.03.5 unbounded behavior for stereo full-graph maps; do not substitute the finite ordinary constant-embedding cap.

exact_map_filter.bijection: Require source and target atom counts and bond counts to be equal, tuple length to equal the source atom count, and mapped target indices to be unique and cover every target atom.
exact_map_filter.bond_correspondence: For every source bond (i,j), target.GetBondBetweenAtoms(map[i], map[j]) must exist and match every bond attribute; equal bond counts then make this a full bond bijection.
exact_map_filter.directional_bond_predicate: For every source bond whose GetBondType() name is in directional_bond_types, the matching target bond must additionally satisfy map[source.GetBeginAtomIdx()] == target.GetBeginAtomIdx() and map[source.GetEndAtomIdx()] == target.GetEndAtomIdx(). Endpoint order is ignored only for bond types outside directional_bond_types.
exact_map_filter.atom_maps: Chem.RemoveStereochemistry does not clear atom maps and graph_test intentionally retains them. Never clear or ignore atom maps; reject any tuple that mismatches atom_map_number even when RDKit substructure matching returned it.

Bond_Double.atom_indices: ascending [reference begin atom index, reference end atom index]

element_schema.changed_elements: Emit only elements whose left_value differs from right_value; the left and right mapped potential-element key sets must otherwise be identical.
element_schema.changed_atom_indices: For each side use the ascending union of atom_indices from every emitted changed element; reference indices are shared, so left and right arrays are identical for a valid stereo row.
element_schema.sort_key: Sort elements by the exact tuple (atom_indices array, bond_indices array, kind, left_value, right_value), using lexicographic integer-array then UTF-8 string ordering; serialize each record object and the record array as sorted-key compact canonical JSON.

stereo_policy.reversal: Keep kind, atom_indices, and bond_indices unchanged, swap left_value and right_value in every element, then reapply element_schema.sort_key. The common reference graph and changed-index arrays remain unchanged.

valid_row.conserved_core_smiles: the exact canonical_nonstereo_full_graph string with no dummy atoms
valid_row.conserved_heavy_atoms: number of heavy atoms in the full canonical reference graph
valid_row.changed_left_atom_indices: ascending canonical heavy-atom indices whose stereo descriptor changes
valid_row.changed_right_atom_indices: ascending canonical heavy-atom indices corresponding to changed stereo elements
valid_row.changed_heavy_atom_fraction: 0/1 because no heavy atom is added or removed
valid_row.stereo_elements: non-empty sorted canonical stereo-element records under candidate_material_schema
valid_row.canonical_nonstereo_full_graph: The exact graph_test string; canonical isomeric SMILES after Chem.RemoveStereochemistry, retaining isotope, charge, connectivity, aromaticity, and bond order.
valid_row.directional_canonical_stereo_record: Sorted canonical stereo-element records from anchor to analog; reversal swaps left_value and right_value.
valid_row.exact_id: Use stereo_exact_transformation_id_material; it is never the empty-fragment ordinary-MMP ID.
valid_row.environment_ids: empty because a cut=0 stereo row has no attachment roots
valid_row.direction: A-to-B and B-to-A are provenance-distinct; each reverses the stereo record but uses the same cut_count and empty attachment arrays.

stereo_policy.invalid_stereo_row: If any explicitness, mapping, or uniqueness condition fails, emit AMBIGUOUS/C3 with all transform fields at their declared invalid sentinels; do not silently downgrade it to VALID_STEREO.

dummy_permutation.single_cut: Normalize the two attachment dummies to atom map 1 on both fragments.
dummy_permutation.double_cut: Enumerate exactly label permutations (1,2) and (2,1), renumber all dummy maps accordingly, canonicalize each fragment and rooted-environment array, and retain the lexicographically minimal complete candidate-material encoding.
dummy_permutation.canonical_encoding: Clear non-attachment atom maps, serialize canonical isomeric SMILES with explicit attachment maps, and compare UTF-8 bytes; this is an isomorphic deduplication rule only, never a chemical ranking tiebreak.

canonicalization.core_matching: Exact canonical labeled-constant matching for single cuts and exact canonical conserved-sidechain matching for double cuts; no fuzzy or learned matching.
canonicalization.canonical_atom_indices: Reparse exact canonical standardized SMILES and use those RDKit atom indices. Different changed-index sets or records across valid maps are ambiguous; molecule IDs never resolve ambiguity.

constant_embedding_recovery.query_construction: Parse the exact canonical labeled constant, record for every allowed attachment label the unique non-dummy atom adjacent to that dummy, remove all attachment dummies, sanitize the remaining possibly disconnected molecule, and preserve the resulting query-atom-to-label-root relation. Reject a view unless it has exactly labels [1] for a single cut or [1,2] for a double cut and exactly one root per label.
constant_embedding_recovery.all_maps: Evaluate every returned match; never retain only the origin map chosen by rdMMPA. If exactly 1000000 matches are returned, apply candidate_generation.constant_embedding_cap_policy and emit AMBIGUOUS/S2.
constant_embedding_recovery.crossing_bonds: For a match, the mapped constant atoms must have exactly cut_count bonds to unmatched atoms, every crossing bond must be incident to one mapped labeled root, and each normalized attachment label must identify exactly one crossing bond. No unmatched crossing bond or unused label is allowed.
constant_embedding_recovery.variable_reconstruction: Construct the induced unmatched-atom graph from the exact canonical standardized molecule. For each crossing bond add one atomic-number-zero dummy to its unmatched endpoint using the original crossing bond type, set only that dummy's atom map to the associated normalized attachment label, set its isotope to zero, clear every non-attachment atom map, and serialize the possibly disconnected result with Chem.MolToSmiles(mol, canonical=True, isomericSmiles=True, kekuleSmiles=False, allBondsExplicit=False, allHsExplicit=False). Retain the embedding only when this exact string equals the normalized variable fragment.
constant_embedding_recovery.changed_indices: The ascending canonical indices of unmatched atoms with atomic number greater than 1; virtual H instead has the contracted empty changed-index array.
constant_embedding_recovery.attachment_roots: The canonical indices of mapped constant atoms adjacent to attachment dummies, ordered by normalized label; these indices alone root the environment arrays.
constant_embedding_recovery.symmetry: Distinct surviving embeddings remain distinct until complete candidate-material byte deduplication. Symmetry-related embeddings with different changed-index arrays or rooted environments may therefore produce an S2 tie; molecule ID and rdMMPA origin order never resolve it.

canonicalization.heavy_atom_count: Count atomic number >1 after canonical reparsing; exclude dummies and hydrogen.
canonicalization.changed_heavy_atom_fraction: Reduced exact rational (removed_heavy_atoms + added_heavy_atoms) / (left_heavy_atoms + right_heavy_atoms); serialize as numerator/denominator with no floating-point rounding.

attachment_environment_rule.construction: For each conserved attachment atom, clone the canonical standardized molecule, clear existing atom maps, call Chem.FindAtomEnvironmentOfRadiusN(mol, radius, atom_idx, useHs=False, enforceSize=False), sort the returned bond IDs, form atom IDs as the sorted union of atom_idx and every incident atom of those bonds, set only the root atom map to 1, and call Chem.MolFragmentToSmiles(mol, atomsToUse=sorted_atom_ids, bondsToUse=sorted_bond_ids, rootedAtAtom=atom_idx, canonical=True, isomericSmiles=True, kekuleSmiles=False, allBondsExplicit=False, allHsExplicit=False). The root is always present even when the bond environment is empty.
attachment_environment_rule.root: The attachment atom is the sole atom-map 1 root, is always included in atomsToUse even for a zero-bond environment, existing maps are cleared, and no dummy is added.
attachment_environment_rule.ordering: Sort atom IDs and bond IDs numerically before MolFragmentToSmiles; for one cut serialize one environment; for two cuts serialize the array in normalized attachment-label order [1,2].
attachment_environment_rule.agreement: Compare exact rooted strings; for two cuts sum equal-string counts independently at each radius.

canonicalization.attachment_environment_id_representation: Compact JSON array of rooted environment strings ordered by normalized attachment label; length one for single cuts and two for double cuts.
canonicalization.candidate_material: Compact canonical JSON object containing cut count, conserved/removed/added labeled fragments, attachment labels, rooted environments, stereo record, virtual-H predicate, changed heavy-atom indices, class, and exact rational.

candidate_material_schema.encoding: UTF-8 JSON object with sorted keys and compact separators; no omitted keys.

keys_and_types.attachment_labels_array: array of integers [1] or [1,2], or [] for stereo
keys_and_types.stereo: object with changed boolean and elements array

stereo_keys_and_types.elements: array of objects with kind string, atom_indices array of integers, bond_indices array of integers, left_value string, right_value string

candidate_material_schema.sort_rule: Atom-index arrays are ascending; attachment arrays follow label order; stereo elements use fragmentation.stereo_policy.element_schema.sort_key; object keys are sorted by canonical JSON encoding.

canonicalization.candidate_digest: Lowercase SHA256 of UTF-8 candidate_material bytes.
canonicalization.tie_material: Compact canonical JSON array of all distinct post-dedup candidate_material objects tied on the five ranking keys, sorted by their canonical bytes; it is [] when no candidate survives and contains candidate material only for valid candidates.
canonicalization.tie_digest: Lowercase SHA256 of UTF-8 tie_material bytes; record tie_count, tie_material, and tie_digest for every pair and episode row, including zero candidates.

tie_serialization.digest: SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON bytes of tie_material); no candidate uses the exact digest 4f53cda18c2baa0c0354bb5f9a3ecbe5ed12ab4d8e11ba873c2f11161202b945

canonicalization.ambiguity: Chemically distinct decompositions tied after all five ranks are AMBIGUOUS and excluded from valid transformations.
canonicalization.unsupported: No valid single- or double-cut decomposition is UNSUPPORTED, not a deterministic terminal failure.

standardization_changed.policy: exclude row; do not terminate the run

multiple_fragments_input.policy: exclude row; do not terminate the run

stereochemistry_unspecified_or_mixed.policy: block stereo-specific record; ordinary non-stereo MMP records remain eligible

ambiguous_decomposition.policy: exclude row; do not terminate the run

inconsistent_direction.policy: exclude row; do not terminate the run

unsupported_anchor_or_decomposition.policy: exclude row; do not terminate the run

ids.hash_encoding: Every ID is lowercase SHA256 hex of UTF-8 compact canonical JSON array bytes: json.dumps(array, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).
ids.v3_spec_hash: The exact extraction.extraction_spec_receipt.sha256 value; it is the first array element of every v3 ID material except direction provenance aliases.
ids.pair_id: transformation_pair_id = SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [v3_spec_hash, lower_standardized_structure_hash, upper_standardized_structure_hash]); lower/upper are lexicographically ordered hashes.
ids.direction_id: direction_id = SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [v3_spec_hash, transformation_pair_id, anchor_standardized_structure_hash, analog_standardized_structure_hash]); pair/anchor/analog provenance only and never part of exact-transformation ID.
ids.exact_transformation_id: exact_transformation_id = SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [v3_spec_hash, removed_labeled_fragment, added_labeled_fragment, attachment_labels_array]); fragment strings are RDKit-canonical, so every virtual-H ID byte uses [H][*:1]; reusable across pairs and directions.
exact_transformation_id_excludes: stereo_element_values unless the stereo-specific material is used
ids.stereo_exact_transformation_id: stereo_exact_transformation_id = SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [v3_spec_hash, canonical_nonstereo_full_graph, directional_canonical_stereo_record]); canonical_nonstereo_full_graph is the exact isotope-preserving fragmentation.stereo_policy graph_test string, so unrelated graphs cannot collide, and directional_canonical_stereo_record is the sorted explicit stereo record for anchor-to-analog direction.
ids.undirected_exchange_id: undirected_exchange_id = SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [v3_spec_hash, sorted_fragment_pair, attachment_arity]); identical for both directions and descriptive only.
ids.transformation_class_id: transformation_class_id = SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [v3_spec_hash, class_token]); direction-invariant class family ID.
ids.pair_direction_class_id_rule: For each direction, derive its class_token from that direction's canonical removed/added fragments and emit the reusable transformation_class_id = SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [v3_spec_hash, class_token]); direction_id separately carries pair/anchor/analog provenance.
ids.environment_level_1_id: environment_level_1_id = SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [v3_spec_hash, exact_transformation_id, anchor_env_radius_1_array, analog_env_radius_1_array]).
ids.environment_level_2_id: environment_level_2_id = SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [v3_spec_hash, exact_transformation_id, anchor_env_radius_2_array, analog_env_radius_2_array]).
ids.directional_environment_selection: For each direction, select the anchor-side and analog-side rooted arrays explicitly at radius 1 and radius 2; build environment IDs from that direction's exact_transformation_id and the two ordered arrays. Reversal swaps anchor and analog arrays and yields distinct directional environment IDs.

conditional_same.transformation_class_id: same if and only if the reversed class token is identical; single_cut_exchange, double_cut_exchange, and stereochemical_change retain the same class ID, while growth/contraction class IDs differ

reversal.class: single_cut_growth reverses to single_cut_contraction; single_cut_contraction reverses to single_cut_growth; single_cut_exchange, double_cut_exchange, and stereochemical_change reverse to themselves.

serialization.csv: RFC4180 CSV, UTF-8, LF line endings, declared header order, one terminal newline; null is an empty field.
serialization.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators for all list/object CSV fields.
serialization.similarity: Finite RDKit Tanimoto serialized as a decimal string with format(value, '.17g'); threshold comparison is inclusive at 0.6.
serialization.booleans: Lowercase JSON booleans true/false inside JSON fields; scalar CSV booleans are exactly true or false.
serialization.lists: Compact JSON arrays; atom-index arrays are ascending integers; warning arrays are sorted unique strings.
serialization.warnings: Compact JSON string array using warning_vocabulary exactly; valid rows use [] and every row-invalid status uses the single declared warning for its failure_code.
serialization.rational: Reduced non-negative integer numerator/denominator string num/den; zero is 0/1.
serialization.stereo: stereo_changed is true/false and stereo_elements is a compact sorted JSON array of canonical element records; empty is [].
serialization.rooted_environments: left/right attachment environments are four explicit compact JSON arrays of canonical rooted SMILES: left/right at radius 1 and left/right at radius 2, each ordered by attachment label.
serialization.virtual_h: virtual_h_eligible is a scalar true/false and is true only under fragmentation.virtual_h_generation.eligible_predicate.

field_rules.similarity: finite decimal string rendered with format(value, '.17g')
field_rules.changed_left_atom_indices: compact JSON array of ascending nonnegative integers
field_rules.changed_right_atom_indices: compact JSON array of ascending nonnegative integers
field_rules.left_attachment_environment_radius_1: compact JSON array of rooted SMILES
field_rules.right_attachment_environment_radius_1: compact JSON array of rooted SMILES
field_rules.left_attachment_environment_radius_2: compact JSON array of rooted SMILES
field_rules.right_attachment_environment_radius_2: compact JSON array of rooted SMILES
field_rules.stereo_elements: compact JSON array of canonical stereo-element objects
field_rules.warnings: exact compact JSON array selected from warning_vocabulary by failure_code; [] for valid rows

serialization.invalid_transform_fields: For invalid statuses, every transform, stereo, virtual-H, candidate-material, and candidate digest field is empty/null/[]/false as declared; structural pair and direction provenance IDs, identity, similarity, status, failure_code, ambiguous, warnings, and tie_count/tie_material/tie_digest remain populated with their status-specific sentinels.

stereochemical_change.assignment: pure full-graph stereo change after non-stereo graph identity; no fragment is removed or added
stereochemical_change.reversal: same class token; stereo values reverse

single_cut_growth.assignment: removed side is exactly the canonical [H][*:1] token and added side contains at least one non-hydrogen heavy atom: H->heavy

single_cut_contraction.assignment: removed side contains at least one non-hydrogen heavy atom and added side is exactly the canonical [H][*:1] token: heavy->H

single_cut_exchange.assignment: removed and added sides each contain at least one non-hydrogen heavy atom: non-H single exchange

double_cut_exchange.assignment: both removed and added labeled sides contain non-hydrogen heavy atoms with two attachment labels: double exchange

class_rules.reusable_class_id_scope: The reusable transformation_class_id is exactly [v3_spec_hash, class_token].
class_rules.class_id_scope: Each pair direction emits only the reusable transformation_class_id for that direction's class token; direction_id remains the separate pair-specific provenance field and never defines reusable class frequency or family support.

pair_population.source: All distinct molecule pairs within a frozen similarity component with inclusive Tanimoto >=0.60, unioned with all expanded episode anchor-query pairs.
pair_population.base_structural_candidates: All within-component >=0.60 candidates; endpoint eligibility never filters transformation_pairs.csv.
pair_population.union_key: transformation_pair_id from standardized structure hashes; extract each union pair once
pair_population.local_endpoint_counts: Retained only as aggregate diagnostics from the exact local-pair replay.
pair_population.local_pair_semantics: true only for a structural pair whose molecules share the same similarity component and whose inclusive Tanimoto similarity is >=0.60; endpoint state never defines local_pair.
pair_population.episode_pair_semantics: true only for a structural anchor-query pair expanded from a public episode; label state never defines episode_pair.

local_pairs.eligibility: Replay exact complete eligible local-pair membership from the frozen topology artifact without parsing numeric magnitudes.
local_pairs.output_role: aggregate diagnostic only; does not restrict the structural union pair population
local_pairs.local_pair_semantics: same component and inclusive Tanimoto >=0.60 only; no endpoint availability is exposed

episodes.selected_anchor_policy: All public rows with episode_policy_id selected_anchor receive endpoint-agnostic structural coverage.
episodes.episode_pair_semantics: structural anchor-query membership only; no endpoint availability or scorable state

serialization.csv: RFC4180 CSV, UTF-8, LF line endings, declared header order, one terminal newline; null is an empty field; scalar booleans are exactly true or false.
serialization.json: UTF-8 JSON; schemas and manifests use sorted keys, two-space indentation, and one terminal newline; JSON-valued CSV fields use sorted keys and compact separators.
serialization.ordering: Pair rows sort by transformation_pair_id; episode rows sort by episode_id then query_rank; frequency keys and status partitions sort lexicographically.
serialization.numbers: Integers are base-10 decimal strings without leading zeroes except zero; finite similarity uses format(value, '.17g'); rational values use reduced numerator/denominator num/den with zero 0/1; no NaN or infinity.
serialization.booleans: Scalar CSV booleans are true/false; JSON booleans are true/false; unavailable fields use the declared empty sentinel, never false.
serialization.lists: Compact JSON arrays; arrays are sorted only where the field rule says sorted, otherwise preserve declared attachment/query order.
serialization.publication: Stage all files in a private directory, validate exact schemas/receipts/bytes, chmod files 0444 and directory 0555, remove private inputs and intermediate artifacts, then publish one terminal directory with Linux renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE); never overwrite or publish a partial directory.
serialization.failure_publication: An integrity failure publishes only failure_receipt.json with no success files; a clean underpowered or supported run publishes exactly the four success files.
serialization.source_and_private_artifacts: Official, generated, target-bearing, test, TDI, and private run artifacts remain outside Git and outside the published terminal.

transformation_pairs.csv.rows: one canonical row per unique union structural candidate pair

field_types.changed_left_atom_indices: compact JSON integer array or empty
field_types.changed_right_atom_indices: compact JSON integer array or empty
field_types.left_attachment_environment_radius_1: compact JSON string array or empty
field_types.right_attachment_environment_radius_1: compact JSON string array or empty
field_types.left_attachment_environment_radius_2: compact JSON string array or empty
field_types.right_attachment_environment_radius_2: compact JSON string array or empty
field_types.stereo_elements: compact JSON object array or empty
field_types.candidate_material: compact JSON object string or empty

tie_field_policy.AMBIGUOUS with S2: tie_count>=2, tie_material contains all tied candidate materials, tie_digest=SHA256(tie_material), candidate_material is empty

field_types.direction_id: lowercase_sha256 provenance ID always populated for a joined pair
field_types.cyp3a4_training_family_exact_support_cou: nonnegative integer string, 0 when invalid or no support
field_types.cyp3a4_training_family_class_support_cou: nonnegative integer string, 0 when invalid or no support

episode_transformations.csv.tie_field_policy: VALID_* rows have tie_count=1 and tie_material=[candidate_material]; AMBIGUOUS/S2 rows have tie_count>=2 and candidate_material empty; all no-candidate statuses have tie_count=0, tie_material=[], and the exact SHA256([]) digest.

counts.local_by_endpoint_value: Exact four-endpoint map whose values use the count_record_fields declared in section_schemas.local_by_endpoint.

status_partition.local_by_endpoint_value: Exact four-endpoint map whose values use the status_record_fields declared in section_schemas.local_by_endpoint.
status_partition.sum_rule: For union, selected_primary, and stress, the six status counts sum exactly to counts[partition].denominator_rows. For each endpoint e, status_partition.local_by_endpoint[e] sums exactly to counts.local_by_endpoint[e].denominator_rows. No status count appears in counts.

fractions.local_by_endpoint_value: Exact four-endpoint map whose values use the fraction_record_fields declared in section_schemas.local_by_endpoint.
fractions.denominator: For union, selected_primary, and stress use counts[partition].denominator_rows. For endpoint e use counts.local_by_endpoint[e].denominator_rows.
fractions.representation: one exact reduced rational num/den string; no decimal fractions

independent_group_support.population: Full valid structural local-pair population across all four endpoint-eligibility partitions, deduplicated by component; endpoint and direction duplication cannot add a family and no held-out exclusion is applied to this overall diagnostic.

valid_changed_heavy_atom_fraction_distri.values: exact reduced rational strings and nonnegative integer counts over valid rows only
valid_changed_heavy_atom_fraction_distri.distribution_order: histogram keys are ascending reduced rational values; median uses the exact lower/upper midpoint rational

fields.cell_support: exactly 15 support records in [repeat, outer_fold] order

selected_anchor_structural_coverage.overall_deduplication: deduplicate distinct component hashes across all selected rows and repeats

fields.fold_cells: exactly 15 records keyed repeat and outer_validation_fold

transformation_coverage.json.status_counts_unit: distinct structural rows in each declared partition; all six row statuses are mutually exhaustive

partitions.local_by_endpoint: four-key endpoint map of distinct endpoint-eligible local pair rows
partitions.selected_primary: expanded selected_anchor rows with structural anchor/query coverage

transformation_coverage.json.fraction_denominator: Each fraction divides by the distinct structural-row denominator of its named partition; status counts are exhaustive.
transformation_coverage.json.fraction_representation: Every fraction is one reduced rational num/den string; zero is 0/1 and denominator is never omitted.
transformation_coverage.json.changed_distribution_denominator: Valid transformation rows only: VALID_STEREO, VALID_SINGLE, VALID_DOUBLE.

frequency_units.exact_transformation_frequency: count of distinct valid directional views per reusable exact_transformation_id; denominator is the union of valid directional views
frequency_units.transformation_class_frequency: count of distinct valid directional views per reusable class token; denominator is the union of valid directional views
frequency_units.two_direction_denominator: Each valid structural pair contributes exactly two directional views, so the denominator is 2 * valid structural pair rows in the partition; invalid rows contribute zero views.
frequency_units.independent_group_support: exact and class maps each contain only full-population families_overall, counting each frozen D-032 component once across endpoint and direction duplication with no held-out exclusion; episode-specific held-out support remains in CSV columns
frequency_units.cross_cyp_valid_transformation_sharing: distinct reusable exact_transformation_id present with valid status in at least two endpoint aggregate partitions

field_types.terminal_integrity_failure_codes: nonempty sorted unique code array; retain every applicable code and select no primary code

support.support_unit: distinct frozen D-032 similarity-component proxy family, never raw pair, direction, episode, query-rank, or repetition

local_validation_fold_arithmetic.validation_molecule_predicate: molecule belongs to the same repeat's held-out side, outer_fold == outer_validation_fold, and has complete direct availability for the endpoint
local_validation_fold_arithmetic.validation_pair_predicate: both molecules satisfy validation_molecule_predicate, share one component, have inclusive Tanimoto >=0.60, and the union row has a valid status
local_validation_fold_arithmetic.pair_unit: distinct canonical unordered standardized-structure-hash pair per cell
local_validation_fold_arithmetic.family_unit: distinct similarity_component_hash among those pairs per cell
local_validation_fold_arithmetic.overall_arithmetic: Across the full local endpoint population, count each valid canonical unordered pair exactly once and each component hash exactly once; do not sum the 15 fold-cell counts.
local_validation_fold_arithmetic.fold_arithmetic: For each of exactly 15 (repeat, outer_validation_fold) cells, count only held-out-side pairs/families under validation_pair_predicate; the training side is excluded.
local_validation_fold_arithmetic.directional_contribution: A pair contributes one pair count, while each valid anchor-to-analog direction may contribute one exact ID/class/environment frequency record; directions never increase pair or family counts.
local_validation_fold_arithmetic.cell_counts: Count pairs and families independently for each of exactly 15 cells; never pool repeats before the gate.
local_validation_fold_arithmetic.held_out_inclusion: Only molecules whose assigned outer_fold equals the cell's outer_validation_fold contribute to that fold-support cell; all training-side molecules are excluded.

overall_units.families: distinct component hashes over all valid complete CYP3A4 local pairs
overall_units.pairs: distinct unordered standardized-structure-hash pairs over all valid complete CYP3A4 local pairs

fold_units.families: distinct component hashes per repeat/outer_validation_fold held-out cell
fold_units.pairs: distinct unordered standardized-structure-hash pairs per repeat/outer_validation_fold held-out cell

local_cyp3a4.gate: overall family and pair thresholds AND every cell family and pair thresholds

episode_training_support_arithmetic.training_family_predicate: A candidate support pair is a distinct training component whose two CYP3A4-complete molecules share one similarity_component_hash, have inclusive Tanimoto >=0.60, have a valid structural row, have component outer_fold != episode.outer_fold, and have component != episode.outer_group_id.
episode_training_support_arithmetic.training_pair_predicate: For the episode cell, use candidate TRAINING local pairs rather than the held-out episode anchor-query pair: both molecules must be CYP3A4 complete, belong to the same component, have similarity >=0.60, have a valid extraction status, and component outer_fold != episode.outer_fold and component != episode.outer_group_id.
episode_training_support_arithmetic.episode_direction_match: A candidate training pair contributes only when its directional anchor-to-analog view matches the episode direction's exact_transformation_id and transformation_class_id; directional provenance IDs may differ by pair.
episode_training_support_arithmetic.distinct_component_rule: Count each distinct component once per episode cell after matching exact ID or class; pair identity, repeated observations, and opposite direction cannot create a second family unit.
episode_training_support_arithmetic.held_out_exclusion: Reject any candidate component with component outer_fold == episode.outer_fold or component == episode.outer_group_id before exact/class matching.
episode_training_support_arithmetic.exact_support: Count distinct training component hashes among candidate training pairs with a valid directional view matching the episode exact_transformation_id; count each family once per episode cell.
episode_training_support_arithmetic.class_support: Count distinct training component hashes among candidate training pairs with a valid directional view matching the episode transformation_class_id; count each family once per episode cell.
episode_training_support_arithmetic.directional_contribution: The episode row preserves one direction_id and one directional class/environment view; support counts remain family sets and never count directions.
episode_training_support_arithmetic.episode_repetition_rule: Each family contributes at most one count per episode cell, regardless of pairs, directions, query rank, or repeated observations.

selected_family_policy.overall_unit: distinct component hashes across selected rows and repeats
selected_family_policy.cell_unit: distinct component hashes per repeat/outer_fold selected cell
selected_family_policy.outer_group_unit: distinct outer_group_id values per repeat/outer_fold selected cell for the endpoint record
selected_family_policy.deduplication: Deduplicate by component hash within each repeat/outer_fold cell; track each distinct outer_group_id once, and repeated episode rows, query rank, direction, and stress policy cannot increase a selected-family count.

episode_training_support_arithmetic.selected_gate: Primary selected_anchor structural coverage requires valid structural anchor/query rows, at least 50 distinct proxy families overall, and at least 5 distinct proxy families in every 15 repeat/fold cells; no selector or scorable fact is read by R4.
episode_training_support_arithmetic.clean_miss: Any clean threshold miss yields R4_TRANSFORMATION_COVERAGE_UNDERPOWERED and forbids an oracle contract.

support.precedence_rule: Integrity failure outranks clean underpowered, which outranks supported.
anti_inflation_rules: Count support by distinct frozen training proxy family.
Exclude the held-out outer group from every training-family set.
Count each union structural pair once.
Count both directions as one pair.
Count each exact transformation and class once per training family.
Episode repetition and query rank cannot increase family support.

authority.status_note: The contract is frozen but unimplemented. A supported run grants geometry/coverage evidence and permission to freeze a separate oracle contract only.

failure_policy.integrity_failure: Receipt, schema, firewall, runtime, atomic-publication, or other integrity failure emits only failure_receipt.json and does not emit coverage artifacts.
failure_policy.clean_underpowered: Emit the four success artifacts with status R4_TRANSFORMATION_COVERAGE_UNDERPOWERED and preserve all coverage evidence.
failure_policy.supported: Emit the four success artifacts with status R4_TRANSFORMATION_COVERAGE_SUPPORTED; do not fit or score anything.

S3.meaning: inconsistent transformation direction or reversal record

C5.meaning: distinct molecule identities share one standardized_structure_hash; molecule ID cannot rescue the collision

P5.meaning: restricted data, secret, or private artifact exposure

P6.meaning: stale, duplicated, or contradictory canonical artifact

terminal_condition_code_map.condition: distinct molecule identities share a standardized_structure_hash
restricted data, secret, or private artifact exposure
stale, duplicated, or contradictory canonical artifact

row_condition_code_map.condition: inconsistent transformation direction or reversal record

failure_policy.row_code_mapping: Each row condition has one code and status in row_condition_code_map; row states never terminate the run.
failure_policy.row_code_precedence_rule: After terminal checks, evaluate applicable row conditions and emit the first code in row_code_precedence; valid rows emit an empty failure_code. C2/C6 standardization hazards therefore outrank stereo/decomposition states, and ambiguity outranks unsupported.
failure_policy.row_failure_code_field_scope: Success-artifact failure_code fields contain only row_exclusion_codes; terminal codes, including C5, appear only in failure_receipt.json.
terminal_integrity_conditions: distinct molecule identities sharing a standardized_structure_hash (C5); fail closed and never use molecule ID as a rescue tiebreak
failure_policy.row_status_policy: AMBIGUOUS, UNSUPPORTED, and STANDARDIZATION_HAZARD are recorded row states and do not terminate a clean run; integrity conditions terminate with failure_receipt.json only.
